title: Moore: Benowitz operation as a 24-hour stage play
summary: Greg Bishop tells of Moore: Benowitz operation as a 24-hour stage play, about late 1970s-early 1980s at Sandia National Laboratories, Albuquerque, and relays what a named person told them. As told, not a fact.
place_text: Kirtland Air Force Base, New Mexico

tellings.quote: imagine the Benowitz operation as a 24-hour long stage play.

plain: Greg Bishop, a writer who has researched UFO deception, says on podcast host Jesse Michels' show that the UFO researcher Bill Moore described the Benowitz operation, an effort around the late 1970s and early 1980s near Kirtland Air Force Base in New Mexico aimed at a man who believed he was picking up alien signals, as a 24-hour stage play. Moore drew on the writing of Harry Rositzke, a former CIA officer. If that is right, it would mean the whole affair was a staged performance put on by government agents.
